Lord '''Kancras''' was a [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Gender/Legends|Male]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] and beast master of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]] stationed within a [[Maelstrom Prison|secret prison]] in the [[Maelstrom Nebula/Legends|Maelstrom Nebula]] during the [[Galactic War]]. He came face to face with the strike team sent to [[Battle of the Maelstrom|rescue]] the imprisoned [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]]. While powerful Kancras was not strong enough to defeat the strike team and met his [[Death/Legends|death]] in the prison.<ref name="TOR:MP" />

==Powers and abilities==
A Sith Lord, Kancras was adept in the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] and also with the famed [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. He was shown to be capable to perform a [[Telekinesis/Legends#Saber throw|lightsaber throw]]. Also as a beast master Kancras was able to command powerful beasts stationed in the Maelstrom Prison, using [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] he was able to boost their abilities when needed.<ref name="TOR:MP" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lord Kancras is one of the bosses that players of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' will have to face in the flashpoint, Maelstrom Prison. The Sith Lord will occasional summon beasts to his aid that players have to deal with.
